name: cut
purpose: Extracts specific columns or character ranges from each line of text or CSV data.
explanation: Splits structured text lines (such as CSV files or space/colon-delimited logs) by a delimiter and prints only the requested columns.

parameters.description: Sets the column delimiter character (default is TAB; e.g. `-d ','` or `-d ':'`).

whenToUse: When extracting specific columns from CSVs, `/etc/passwd`, or delimited log files in a pipe.
commonMistakes: Forgetting `-d ' '` when splitting space-separated text (default delimiter is TAB, not space).
explanationOfOutput: Outputs only fields 1 and 2 separated by the specified delimiter for every line.
commonErrors: `cut: the delimiter must be a single character`
